liebermann.description_de: Phillipps 8078, dann H. S. Nichols & Co. zu London
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Phillipps MS 8078 (in 1903 owned by H. S. Nichols & Co., London)
liebermann.laws: ECf, Lib Lond, In Cn, Wl art
liebermann.notes: Written c. 1300, at Phillipps's until 1895, then owned by H. S. Nichols & Co., London. In the starred pieces it agrees with S but sometimes reads better, so it derives from sp: ECf, Libertas Londoniensis, Instituta Cnuti, Huntingdon's 'Chnutus rex cum XX annis', the Tripartita (Wl art, Genealogia Normannica to John), De longitudine Anglie, Glanvill and other pieces. Per f. 25 the exemplar of Pl and S followed the Ip Hunt class for In Cn and Tripartita.

others.text: O’Brien (2003): with College of Arms Vincent 98 and BL Harley 785 descends from a lost manuscript (his π), itself a sister of S.
